_doc: Reviewed concept assignments (src/catalog/conceptAssignments.js): concepts for products the rules leave unassigned. Proposed by tools/embeddings (nearest reviewed neighbours above the holdout threshold), screened through the catalogue checks, required to share a word with the concept, and decided concept group by concept group by the products session (3.10, approved by Naor). Not verified records - the product keeps verified:false. Applied only where the rules found no concept and no verified record decided one.
